**Triage: `pm:queue` + `domain:engine-core`.**

**Landing site.** `packages/formula/src/cel-engine.ts` — `classifyError` verified verbatim on `origin/main` at **`:803-809`**, matching the quoted body character for character (default `'runtime'`, three keyword branches). `packages/formula` is on the `domain:engine-core` row of the SKILL domain table (CEL / `matches-filter` / RLS predicate evaluation). Routed by landing site, not by the title's "REST response" vocabulary — the REST and rule-validator sites the body lists are **consumers** that re-emit `kind`, not the fix site.

**The freeze does not apply.** The 2026-08-05 maintainer freeze on the `driver-memory` / `driver-mongodb` families (anchor #5499) explicitly exempts `formula` and `driver-sql`. This is `formula`, so it queues normally — recording it so a later sweep does not re-derive the question.

**Why a defect rather than an observation.** Named file, five-row repro table, and a user-visible blast radius the filer did not overstate: `kind` is string-interpolated into the author-facing rejection text (`rule-validator.ts:1262` / `:1417`, `cel-fault.ts:75`) and into the HTTP `reason` field (`rest-server.ts:571`). A missing closing paren — one of the most common hand-written syntax errors there is — is reported to the author as `runtime`, i.e. pointed at their data instead of at their expression. ADR-0032 D1d asks these messages to be self-correcting; this one misdirects.

**Not `target:v17`.** The `message` is correct and complete; only the classification is wrong, so the author still sees `Expected RPAREN, got EOF` and can act. Misdirection, not data loss, silent drop, security, or an unusable surface ⇒ improvement-class for release purposes. Flagging the judgement explicitly so it can be overridden cheaply if the maintainer reads the misclassification as a first-hour-experience item.

**Direction — the issue's own framing survives triage, and is worth preserving into dispatch.** Topping up the keyword table is stop-the-bleeding; classifying off cel-js's structured error object (`ErrorOptions.code`, `lib/index.d.ts:82-86`) is the actual fix, because the root cause is *classifying on prose* — the table breaks again on the next cel-js wording change. Whoever claims it should establish whether the structured field discriminates all cases before falling back, and pin one fixture per wording class either way.

**Stale-premise check.** `git log origin/main -- packages/formula/src/cel-engine.ts` — most recent is `58f3220` (#4812 / PR #6130, the PR this was discovered from). That PR deliberately did **not** assert the classification, so nothing has pinned the bug as contract.

**Dedup (full enumeration; search API unavailable to this seat).** No open issue or PR in any of the three repos covers CEL error classification. #6071 (`ExecutionContext` drift) matched only on the substring "kind" and is unrelated.

PR #6202 验收通过,已翻 ready + auto-merge(CI 23 项全绿)。要点记档:① 两条前提诚实证伪 —— 洞的规模是 20 类 parse code 漏 16 类(非单据列举的 5 条),且派发令里的目标 kind `'syntax'` 词表无此格,按词表现实取 `'parse'`(裁定:采纳,派发令措辞不精确,dev 处置正确);② 实现路线偏离(按错误类判定取代补关键词)由决定性实测背书:cel-js 把作者源码嵌进 message,字段名能决定分类(`'((record.type_id)'` 被判 type)—— 补词表原理上补不对,而错误类是 public 契约(index.d.ts 导出);关键词表逐字保留作非 ParseError 兜底,严格非回归;③ type/runtime 两支刻意不动的理由成立(cel-js 按阶段选错误类,整体结构化会迁移今天正确的判定),反向残留已立 **#6223** 交分诊;④ 消费面 pin 落在字符串成形处(objectql 只读验证),AGENTS §9 dist 陈旧陷阱的方法学记录有价值;⑤ #6132 定价参考(错误类可共用、缺 limits 的行为变更点)已入档。
